arise.npc.herald.greeting: I speak for the System. Click to listen.
arise.herald.greeting: You are not dead. You were stopped an instant before, and that is why you are here. I am the Herald: I speak for the System, and from today it watches you.
arise.herald.system: The System measures. Every creature you bring down tells it something about you, and when it has seen enough it hands back a level. The panel in the top left is its voice: it will never lie to you.
arise.herald.quests: I will not ask for everything at once. One quest at a time, and each one opens something you did not have: stats, the army, the gates. Do what it says and the next door opens on its own.
arise.herald.keys: %1$s to see what you are becoming. %2$s for your quests. %3$s for the world map, which marks the cities and every open gate.
arise.herald.army: What you kill should not stay on the ground. When the System allows it, %1$s beside a fresh corpse will take its shadow, %2$s will call it to your side, and %3$s will let you command the army. That is how you stop fighting alone.
arise.herald.farewell: Now go back. The place where you were about to die is still there, and so is the thing that was killing you — but you are no longer the one who left it. Arise.

arise.tutorial.welcome.2: The System chooses those who come within a step of the end. Try not to get there too soon.

arise.unlock.abilities.hint: The four abilities sit above the hotbar and cast from %1$s to %2$s: they open as you level.
arise.unlock.gear.hint: %s opens the Hunter's menu: slots unlock with your rank.
arise.unlock.gates.hint: Gates open near you on their own: click one to survey it before entering, and %s marks it on your map.
arise.unlock.shop.hint: %s opens the Abyss Shop: the stock rotates, and what you don't buy is gone.
arise.unlock.cities.hint: The Desk in any Association will take you to the other four cities.
arise.unlock.gems.hint: Gems are set at the Association bench, or at the market's Jeweller.
arise.unlock.coin.hint: At the Bank of the Abyss: click to mint soul coin into coins, shift-click to bring them back.
arise.unlock.workshop.hint: Surplus souls become workers: machines are built from Blueprints.
arise.unlock.lure.hint: The Soul Lure gathers loose souls by itself, as long as it has something to work with.
arise.unlock.crucible.hint: The Crucible fuses four souls into one of a higher rank.
arise.unlock.forge.hint: The Shadow Forge smelts without fuel: the working souls are the fire.
arise.unlock.well.hint: The Abyss Well turns the souls' labour into soul coin.
arise.unlock.enlist.hint: A loose soul can fight again: enlist it into your army.
arise.unlock.services.hint: The Broker opens a gate to order, at your rank, for a fee.
arise.unlock.mastery.hint: Nothing is missing now: from here the System falls silent and watches.
arise.tutorial.built: Hall of Awakening standing at %1$s %2$s %3$s, in the gate dimension.
arise.gear.unique.eye_of_darkness.lore: The System's first gift. Whoever wears it has no excuse left to fear the dark.
arise.msg.gate.exit_open: The guardian has fallen. The way home has opened in its hall: touch the stone to return.
arise.msg.shadow.recalled_travel: The army does not cross worlds: %s shadows returned.
arise.quest.awakening.lore: The System does not choose the strong: it chooses those who reach the edge and do not cross it.
arise.quest.awakening.brief: There is nothing to prepare. Keep living, and let the world try.
arise.quest.first_steps.lore: Before it grants you anything, the System measures how much you can carry. Levels are its unit.
arise.quest.first_steps.brief: Experience comes from killing. The panel in the top left says how far the next level is.
arise.quest.the_army.lore: Every creature that falls leaves something nobody else can see. The System wants to be sure you have seen enough of them.
arise.quest.the_army.brief: Any hostile creature counts, killed by you or by your shadows. The tally appears above the hotbar.
arise.quest.first_shadow.lore: A body that has just fallen holds its shadow a little longer. Then it disperses, and that soldier will not come back.
arise.quest.first_shadow.brief: Press %s beside a fresh corpse: you have a few seconds before the shadow is gone.
arise.quest.the_power.lore: A power merely owned is not a power: it is a weight nobody asked you to carry.
arise.quest.the_power.brief: Abilities cast from %1$s to %2$s and sit above the hotbar. The dim ones are waiting for the level written on them.
arise.quest.equipped.lore: The System will not dress you. It hands you the pieces; where they go is your business.
arise.quest.equipped.brief: Open the Hunter's menu with %s. Hold shift and click a piece: it goes straight to its slot.
arise.quest.first_gate.lore: Gates open by themselves, where the world is thinnest. Closing one means going in and felling what holds it open.
arise.quest.first_gate.brief: Click the gate to survey it before entering; %s marks it on your map. Inside, when the guardian falls, the return stone appears in its hall.
arise.quest.the_trade.lore: The Abyss gives nothing away, but it trades gladly. The soul coin you have gathered is worth something outside you too.
arise.quest.the_trade.brief: Open the Abyss Shop with %s. The stock rotates: what you don't buy is gone next rotation.
arise.quest.the_association.lore: Where Hunters are many, they have built. Five cities, and in each one a door with the same crest.
arise.quest.the_association.brief: The Seal you have just received opens the list of cities from anywhere in the world: hold it and right-click. %s shows you where they are.
arise.quest.the_market.lore: Behind every counter is someone who stopped walking into gates and started selling to those who do.
arise.quest.the_market.brief: There are nine shops on the square. Right-click whoever stands behind a counter: sellers open the trading window, services just do their thing.
arise.quest.the_mint.lore: A soul coin inside the System is a number. A Soul Coin is an object: you hold it, you spend it, you lose it.
arise.quest.the_mint.brief: At the Bank of the Abyss: click to mint, shift-click to bring coins back. The Bank keeps a cut on the way back.
arise.quest.the_surplus.lore: The army has a limit. What you extract beyond it is not lost: it stays a loose soul, with no body and no duties.
arise.quest.the_surplus.brief: Extract with a full army, or dismiss a shadow: either way you end up holding a Loose Soul.
arise.quest.the_lure.lore: A soul that does not fight can work. That is the difference between a Monarch and a gravedigger.
arise.quest.the_lure.brief: Craft the Soul Lure at a workbench — the recipe has just appeared in your book — place it, and put a Loose Soul inside. The Blueprint is used up.
arise.quest.the_fusion.lore: Four weak souls do not make a strong one on their own: something has to hold them together while they melt.
arise.quest.the_fusion.brief: In the Crucible: four souls of the same rank plus a catalyst. One comes out, a rank higher.
arise.quest.the_forge.lore: Fire costs. Working souls do not: they burn what is left of them, and you need nothing else.
arise.quest.the_forge.brief: The Shadow Forge smelts like a furnace, but the fuel is the souls installed in it. Load the ore and let it work.
arise.quest.the_well.lore: The Abyss pays those who send it souls to work. Not generosity: a wage withheld at the source.
arise.quest.the_well.brief: The Abyss Well turns the souls' labour into soul coin, by itself, as long as it holds souls.
arise.quest.the_recruit.lore: A soul that has worked long enough can fight again. Few things are more loyal than a soldier who has been a labourer.
arise.quest.the_recruit.brief: Open the army and enlist a Loose Soul: it becomes a shadow again, at the rank it holds now.
arise.quest.the_broker.brief: At the Gate Broker, on the square: you pay, and a gate of your rank opens where you stand.
arise.stat.vitality.desc: More hearts on the bar. The most direct way not to die.
arise.stat.agility.desc: You move faster. Past a point the client cannot keep up with the physics: that is what the cap is for.
arise.stat.strength.desc: Every swing takes more life. It adds to the weapon's damage, it does not replace it.
arise.stat.endurance.desc: Armour: it cuts the damage that lands. Good against almost everything, not against hunger or the void.
arise.stat.toughness.desc: Cuts how far big hits punch through armour. It only counts if you have armour.
arise.stat.haste.desc: You strike more often. A swing before the bar refills lands for a fraction: this shortens the wait.
arise.stat.resolve.desc: You get pushed less when hit. At one, you stop being pushed at all.
arise.stat.reach.desc: You reach entities further away without stepping closer.
arise.stat.absorption.desc: Extra yellow hearts: they take the hit first and never regenerate.
arise.stat.fortune.desc: Better loot from everything the game rolls at random.
arise.blueprint.recipe: An ingredient in the %s recipe: the full grid is in your recipe book.
arise.blueprint.consumed: The Blueprint is used up in the build.
